main_text.l: λίσπη φθογγή. Et enim tongue, Græcum
λαχμὸς, fors, luck & luckie: quanquam dubito
utrum ex eâdem sint origine: & non
potiùs luckie, fit ex λευκὸς, candidus,
ἡμέρα, fœlix & faufta dies: Angli, a luckie day.
Λεύσσω, video, aspicio; to looke: quod
minùs remotum, quàm βλέπω; ex quo
Λύω, λύσαι, folvere; to loose: Λυσιμάχιον,
quasi dicas, λυσιπόλιον. Vide infrà in
rum, λύειν πόλιν, evertere, perdere ur-
bem, &c.) to lose, id est, perdere, amit-
